The remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is the second game in the series based on initial retail sales in the UK

The updated version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is selling very well in the UK,
claims
journalist Christopher Dring from The Game Business. According to his data, the game has shown the second-best launch in the franchise in terms of the number of physical copies sold in the country.
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Dring’s statistics only consider retail sales in the debut week. The exact sales numbers for the Ocarina of Time remake were not specified.
The journalist notes that among the series’ games, only Tears of the Kingdom had a better retail launch in the UK. It outsold the remake by nearly two times. For instance, Breath of the Wild sold 35% less during its release week compared to the new Ocarina of Time.
Additionally, the release of the Ocarina of Time remake was the largest in UK retail among all games in 2026. The newcomer surpassed Resident Evil: Requiem, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, EA Sports FC 27, and other hits.
The Ocarina of Time remake was released on November 5th exclusively for the Nintendo Switch 2.
